channel.desc: Simply Kpop New StageNStory\" expands the existing stage-oriented format of Simply K-Pop to plan a new type of music broadcast that combines idol performance stage + talk and fan communication. Through the twice-weekly (once live/once recorded broadcast), idol groups will release stories that they have not been able to do on the show, and mix music shows and talk by alternately showing talk and performance stages.
